title: Quick Lazy-Sunday Tomato Raclette
description: A pescatarian-friendly, easy-to-make raclette dish featuring a rich, aerated tomato sauce and tangy nuka-pickle.
instructions: Prepare the tomato sauce by heating it in a saucepan over medium heat until warmed through.
Add the nuka-pickle to the saucepan with the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Meanwhile, melt 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked shrimp to the raclette grill and top with the tomato sauce and nuka-pickle mixture.
Sprinkle the raclette cheese over the top of the sauce and nuka-pickle mixture.
Place the raclette grill under the broiler and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the raclette grill from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the Quick Lazy-Sunday Tomato Raclette immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
